Subject: Post-call: International model suitability & pilot next steps (EU / APAC locales)

Hi Eva / Sachin —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we all have alignment: 

Summary of needs we noted:
- Fintech EU: high-accuracy instruction following in FR/DE/NL for KYC messaging and policy excerpts; strict character-level handling for diacritics and legal abbreviations.
- APAC pilot: JA/KO with high-fidelity named-entity handling and low hallucination for invoice parsing.
- Both: GDPR data handling, encryption at rest, and audit logs required for pilot.

Initial model recommendations (for a 4-week pilot run):
1) Redwood-Optimized-m2 (quantized, 13B) — good latency/cost balance; preserves casing/diacritics better in our internal tests.
2) Llama2-13B-q4 (instruction-tuned) — strong instruction-following baseline, useful for comparative AB runs.
3) Mistral-instruct-8x (if customer wants higher single-request quality) — costs more but reduces instruction-drop errors on long prompts.

Deliverables we’ll provide for the pilot:
- Locale prompt sets (attached: prompt-sets-eu-apac.json) for FR/DE/NL/FI/JA/KO.
- Benchmark summary and suggested metrics (attached: locale-benchmark-summary.csv).
- Eval runbook (attached: madlib-eval-plan.pdf) outlining sampling, human labeling plan, and regression checks.

Open / asks for you: 
- Confirm locales you want in scope for the pilot (I noted FR/DE/NL + JA/KO, you asked about FI — please confirm).
- Share the security questionnaire if you want us to preload answers (we can provide SOC2 report + security appendix).
- Budget range for pilot so we can size reserved capacity (estimate below).

Estimated pilot outline (ballpark):
- 4 weeks, 3 models (2 AB variants + control), up to 150k tokens/week — estimated hosted cost $6k–$12k depending on concurrency and QA labeling.

Proposed next steps (pick one):
- I: Sign pilot SOW (I’ll send DocuSign and a concise statement of work).
- II: Run a 1-week smoke eval on your representative prompts (no charge) to sanity-check locales and tokenization.
- III: Schedule a 30-min runbook sync with our Applied ML/QA (Neha) and Product (Marcus) to finalize metrics.

I’ll loop Neha and Marcus on the runbook and timelines below. Thanks — happy to adjust based on your compliance needs.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Locales: Please add Finnish (FI) and keep Latvian on standby — we may scope it in the second week. Primary pilot: FR, DE, NL, FI.
2) Security: I attached our standard security questionnaire — could you return a completed copy and SOC2 evidence? (I attached: security-questionnaire-fintech-eu.pdf).
3) Diacritics / tokenization: We’ve seen issues historically where quantized models split accented tokens unpredictably and that affects NER on names/addresses. Can you confirm which model (from your list) demonstrably preserves diacritics in the output and explain the mitigation plan (e.g., token-level postprocessing, fine-tuning)?
4) Pricing: the budget estimate looks fine; please provide a version with clear line items for (a) inference hosting, (b) human labeling, (c) reserved capacity.

Also: We have a procurement freeze the week of Dec 20–24; if possible we’d like any DocuSign/contract to be completed before the 20th to avoid delays.

Thanks — eva

Subject: Fwd: Post-call: International model suitability & pilot next steps (EU / APAC locales)

Neha / Marcus — forwarding Eva’s reply (attached questionnaire). Two immediate asks: 

1) Technical: Eva is worried about diacritics and tokenization behavior in quantized models. Can we propose a mitigation that we can commit to in the pilot scope? Options I see: 
   - Pre/post-token normalization and canonicalization for NER fields (low effort).
   - Run the Redwood-Optimized-m2 variant with a token-preservation kernel we’ve been validating on EU corpora (Neha, is this the kernel with delta patch we tested last month?).
   - If required, a small finetune over 1–2k domain-specific examples — higher cost but fast.

2) Eval plan: I sketched a 2-week smoke + 4-week pilot. Proposed locales for smoke: FR/DE/JA. Full pilot: FR/DE/NL/FI/JA/KO. Marcus, can you confirm if we have the reserved capacity headroom for a 4-week run starting Jan 4?

I attached a draft eval runbook (madlib-eval-plan.pdf) and the prompt sets. Key metrics we should commit to in the SOW: instruction-following score (0–5), locale-specific NER precision, hallucination rate (manual label), and response latency P95.

Suggested owners / timeline: 
- Neha: run smoke eval + technical mitigation design (deliverable in 3 business days).
- Marcus: capacity & pricing estimate (line items by inference, labeling, reserved capacity) — deliverable EOD 12/17.
- Soojin: contract & schedule coordination, DocuSign flow.

If we can return the questionnaire answers and SOC2 by EOD 12/17 we should be able to start the smoke eval before the holiday window.

Thanks — Soojin
